'''Maxiron Agolerga'''<ref name="BMF54" /> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="AOTC" /> who was [[Pontifex]] of the [[Brotherhood of Cognizance]].<ref name="BMF54" /> In [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala]] to [[22 BBY]].</ref> he was one of only around twenty [[hermit]]s in the order and became the first Pontifex to legitimise a [[marriage]] in over 300 [[Standard year|years]] when he secretly officiated the [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala|wedding]] of [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. The ceremony took place on a balcony of the [[Varykino]] retreat in the [[Lake Country]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]<ref name="BMF54" /> and was witnessed only by the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]]. Agolerga had light skin and wore dark [[Clothing|robes]] for the ceremony.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maxiron Agolerga first appeared in the [[2002]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="AOTC" /> The scenes at Varykino were filmed in [[Villa del Balbianello]] on [[Lake Como]] in [[Wikipedia:Italy|Italy]]. The wedding scene was nearly postponed by overnight rainfall, but the skies cleared fifteen minutes before the shoot. In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Agolerga's name was first used in the [[2016]] magazine [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 54|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 54]].<ref name="BMF54" />

In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the character appeared prior to the film in its 2002 [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|novelization]] by [[R. A. Salvatore]]<ref name="Novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> and was identified by [[Tim Veekhoven]] through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature ''[[What's The Story?]]'' in an entry written in [[2007]]. Veekhoven named Agolerga after Manuel Aringarosa, a character from [[Wikipedia:Dan Brown|Dan Brown's]] [[Wikipedia:The Da Vinci Code|''The Da Vinci Code'']].<ref name="blog">{{Blog|teekay-421|13|They were the chosen ones}}</ref>
